LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LargeRefugeeWave.label: A large refugee wave
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LargeRefugeeWave.letterTex: A large crowd of Ratkin, frantic with hunger, is pouring toward the colony. They seek food rather than a fight, and will leave after eating.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AbandonedRatkinChildren.le: A Ratkin mother has arrived with her young and is heading straight for your food stores. She will leave once all the children are in place. They will then become wild wanderers.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ShatteredMother.label: A mother torn apart
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ShatteredMother.letterText: A dying Ratkin lies at the edge of the map. Meanwhile, a group of Ratkin young is crossing the colony, moving on as though nothing happened.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarFamily.label: A begging mother
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarFamily.letterText: A mother and four Ratkin young have arrived at the edge of the colony. They do not seek a fight, only a little food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarGroup.label: Ratkin beggars
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarGroup.letterText: Hungry Ratkin refugees have arrived. They will beg colonists for food first. If nobody helps, they will search for it themselves.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefRatkinGroup.label: Ratkin thieves
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefRatkinGroup.letterTex: Hungry Ratkin have slipped into the colony in search of food. You can take them in or drive them away by force.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ThiefRatkinChildGroup.lett: Ratkin young have slipped into the colony, eating and carrying away food. You can take them in or drive them away by force.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildRatkinWandersIn.label: A wild Ratkin wanderer
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildRatkinWandersIn.letter: A starving wild Ratkin has appeared. They have no faction and can be tamed like a wild person.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildRatkinChildWandersIn.l: A starving wild Ratkin child has appeared. They have no faction and can be tamed like a wild person.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_WildRatkinGroupWandersIn.l: Hungry wild Ratkin have appeared at the edge of the map. They have no faction and will roam like wild people.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_FamineRefugees.label: Famine refugees
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_FamineRefugees.letterText: Ratkin driven to desperation by famine have reached the colony and asked to join. They are frighteningly thin, but still alive.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RatkinTraderCaravan.label: A refugee caravan
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RatkinTraderCaravan.letter: A Ratkin trader has arrived with captive Ratkin young. She handles the negotiations; those purchased will become prisoners.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchange.label: Exchanging children for food
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_ChildExchange.letterText: A Ratkin trader has arrived with a group of young. Send a colonist to negotiate an exchange involving a colonist, prisoner or slave baby. The trader will leave if no deal is made within 24 hours.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarSiege.label: A siege of beggars
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_BeggarSiege.letterText: Ratkin refugees have surrounded your colony. They repeatedly beg rather than attacking outright. They will leave after carrying five units of food or stealing and eating one.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_SimpleMeal.label: Refugee aid (simple meals)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_SimpleMeal.letterText: Ratkin refugees are asking for aid. They need simple meals.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_FineMeal.label: Refugee aid (fine meals)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_FineMeal.letterText: Ratkin refugees are asking for aid. They hope to receive fine meals.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_Medicine.label: Refugee aid (medicine)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_Medicine.letterText: Ratkin refugees are asking for aid. They urgently need medicine.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_Silver.label: Refugee aid (silver)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_Silver.letterText: Ratkin refugees are asking for aid. They request silver.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_Baby.label: Refugee aid (a baby)
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Aid_Baby.letterText: Ratkin refugees are asking for a baby who is a prisoner or slave.
The Ratkin offer information about a treasure in exchange for simple meals.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Treasure_Herbal.lett: The Ratkin offer information about a treasure in exchange for herbal medicine.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Treasure_Silver.lett: The Ratkin offer information about a treasure in exchange for silver.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Structure_SimpleMeal: The Ratkin offer the location of some ruins in exchange for simple meals.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Structure_Herbal.let: The Ratkin offer the location of some ruins in exchange for herbal medicine.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Structure_Silver.let: The Ratkin offer the location of some ruins in exchange for silver.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Settlement_SimpleMea: The Ratkin offer the location of a small settlement in exchange for simple meals.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Settlement_Herbal.le: The Ratkin offer the location of a small settlement in exchange for herbal medicine.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Intel_Settlement_Silver.le: The Ratkin offer the location of a small settlement in exchange for silver.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueWanderers.label: Infected wanderers
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueWanderers.letterText: Wild Ratkin carrying Ratkin plague have appeared near the colony. They wander as though searching for hope.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueAbandonedBabies.lett: A mother with Ratkin plague has arrived at the map edge with her newborn babies. They are all seriously ill.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueTraderCaravan.label: An infected trade caravan
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueTraderCaravan.letter: A refugee trade caravan has arrived, but its leader has Ratkin plague. Nobody mentions it. Nobody dares.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlaguePassersby.label: Infected travelers
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlaguePassersby.letterText: Ratkin carrying plague are passing through your colony on their way elsewhere. They are ordinary travelers, but still dangerous.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueRefugees.label: Plague refugees
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueRefugees.letterText: Ratkin plague refugees have reached the colony and are asking to join.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueOrphan.label: A plague orphan
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueOrphan.letterText: A Ratkin child with plague has appeared in your colony. Without help, they may not live long.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueBeggarGroup.label: Infected beggars
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueBeggarGroup.letterTe: Infected Ratkin are wandering through the colony and eating your rice.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueThiefGroup.label: Infected thieves
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueThiefGroup.letterTex: Even with plague, these Ratkin have come to steal your rice.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LaboringRefugees.label: Refugees in labor
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_LaboringRefugees.letterTex: Frail, hungry Ratkin refugees have arrived at the map edge. They are about to give birth and will go into labor as soon as they enter.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueLaboringRefugees.let: Infected Ratkin refugees have arrived at the map edge. They carry plague and will go into labor as soon as they enter.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_StrongSiege.label: A fierce siege
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_StrongSiege.letterText: Refugees have set their sights on your colony. They intend to steal food and leave, but will attack if their route is blocked.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueStrongSiege.label: An infected siege
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueStrongSiege.letterTe: Infected refugees have set their sights on your colony. They intend to steal food and leave, but will attack if their route is blocked.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Passersby.label: Ratkin passing through
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Passersby.letterText: Ratkin travelers are passing through the colony. They are ordinary travelers and will soon continue their journey.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AirdropMistake.label: A misdirected airdrop
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AirdropMistake.letterText: Ratkin babies meant for somewhere else have been dropped into your colony by mistake. They are only three days old and will remain here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueAirdropMistake.label: An infected airdrop
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueAirdropMistake.lette: Ratkin babies meant for somewhere else have been dropped into your colony by mistake. They carry plague, are only three days old, and will remain here.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_MisguidedKinship.label: Mistaken identity
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_MisguidedKinship.letterTex: Ratkin young with harmful traits have crawled to your door, calling for their mother. If you refuse them, they will treat this place as a wild nest and search for food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueMisguidedKinship.let: Ratkin young with harmful traits and plague have crawled to your door, calling for their mother. If you refuse them, they will treat this place as a wild nest and search for food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GreatFamine.label: The Great Famine
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GreatFamine.letterText: A mass of famine-stricken Ratkin has flooded into your colony. Hunger has stripped away all restraint. They will eat or gnaw anything they can reach.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueGreatFamine.label: Famine and plague
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueGreatFamine.letterTe: A mass of infected, famine-stricken Ratkin has flooded into your colony. Hunger has stripped away all restraint. They will eat or gnaw anything they can reach.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueRevenge.label: Plague revenge
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueRevenge.letterText: You seem to have angered someone formidable. A large group of dying plague victims is being dropped into your colony at once.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_CaravanMuggers.label: Refugees rob a caravan
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_PlagueCaravanMuggers.label: Infected refugees rob a caravan
